source: A Night Off design doc pp. 32-34 (The Monkey's cast, 20 unique regulars). Celeste is the bartender (the Bartender, not a patron) and the Marlin is the stuffed fish over the library fire (it speaks only at the seance); the five who travel between the bars (Boxer Mags, Captain Vane, Sweet Wren, Bartholomew Crane and Dottie Finch) are in nightoff_patrons.json with "travels": true. Tonight's bar for each traveller is rolled from the night's seed.

regulars.name: Lord Ashby
regulars.secret: Has lost his house twice at the high-stakes table and won it back once

regulars.name: Horace
regulars.secret: Mrs. Vantage's husband; the roof is his favourite place to settle things

regulars.name: Dr. Quince
regulars.secret: A surgeon; recognises a stitch; for a drink he'll tell you which flirt carries a cooler

regulars.name: Madame Ostrova
regulars.secret: Runs a seance in the library at midnight; the stuffed marlin answers

regulars.name: The Honourable Pim
regulars.secret: Rich in title, poor in fact: going home with him is a cold attic and a sincere breakfast

regulars.name: Sergeant Mallory
regulars.secret: Off-duty police: a fight near him is an inspection

regulars.name: Lady Ophelia Crane
regulars.secret: The Monkey's kidney thief; works alone

regulars.name: Mr. Sable
regulars.secret: The cartel's banker at the high-stakes table

regulars.name: Thistle
regulars.secret: Owns the chair by the fire; the only loud person Celeste tolerates

regulars.name: Cordelia Fen
regulars.secret: A widow who comes to the roof to look at the Gull, where her husband drank

regulars.name: Anselm
regulars.tell: touches his bow tie when a player is cheating

regulars.name: Juniper Vale
regulars.secret: Reads the roof's telescope like a fortune; knows when the police are crossing the harbour

drinks.name: The Sidecar
drinks.line: Celeste makes it exactly right, and tells you so.

drinks.name: The Marlin
drinks.line: A billiards buff: the cue's wobble halved for a minute.

drinks.name: The Widow's Kiss
drinks.line: Honest captions, and you see every patron's traits for 2 minutes.

drinks.name: Champagne (the bottle)
drinks.line: A round for the room, poured from the bottle. Everyone loves you a little.
